in_urdu.name: آریشا

in_pashto.name: اریشه

data.cultural_impact: The name Arisha might not have a distinctive cultural association as it is relatively uncommon and can be found across various Muslim communities. However, it's a beautiful name that carries a sense of grace and elegance, often associated with purity, sophistication and prosperity. In many Middle Eastern cultures, it is customary to assign names with deep meaning and significance, which makes a name like Arisha an appreciate choice.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Arisha holds great spiritual significance through its Arabic roots, which can be traced back to the meaning "a precious gift from Allah" or "a favor bestowed by Allah". It is believed that the bestowal of a name can have a profound impact on an individual's life, as the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) once said, "Call your child by a good name, for it is a part of his religion" (Sahih Muslim, Book 33). With the name Arisha, one is constantly reminded of the divine blessings and favors that come from Allah, and that every good thing comes from Him – a source of inspiration and gratitude.
